items.title: On-Device Speech Recognition and Text-to-Speech in Google AI Edge Gallery
items.summary: Google AI Edge Gallery now supports on-device, offline Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Text-to-Speech (TTS) capabilities for building developer-friendly voice applications. Developers can leverage ML Kit for optimized Android performance, or use MediaPipe Tasks and LiteRT for cross-platform open-weight model integration. This local pipeline seamlessly pairs lightweight speech models with on-device small language models like Gemini Nano and Gemma 4 to enable real-time streaming transcription and low-latency synthesis.
